decisive_items: severe generalized bullous and pustular rash
response.rationale: The acute pustular eruption after rapid hydroxychloroquine rechallenge, with biopsy-proven subcorneal neutrophilic pustules and spongiosis, is classic for acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis. Toxic epidermal necrolysis and Stevens-Johnson syndrome typically show full-thickness epidermal necrosis and are not primarily pustular.

rejected.why: No epidermal necrosis or other TEN-defining features; the presentation is predominantly pustular with subcorneal neutrophilic collections.
SJS lacks the characteristic subcorneal pustular histology and acute generalized pustular morphology described here.
